mapper.delete: delete a,b from u_patrol_task a join u_patrol_task_attr b on a.task_id = b.task_id where a.create_time < #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
delete a,b from u_patrol_result a join u_patrol_data_result b on a.task_id = b.task_id where a.create_time < #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
delete from sys_logs a where a.create_time < #{expireDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
